source.text: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀אַשְׁרֵי־אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְוֺתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise Yah! How blessed [is] a man [who] fears YHWH, [who] in his commandments delights greatly.

en.L: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! How blessed [is] {{gender:the person|the man}} [who] fears {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [who] delights greatly in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands!
en.B: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! How blessed are all who fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, whose great delight is in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands!
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Life is truly good for people who fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and love to do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commands.

fr.L: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Heureux {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} [qui] craint {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [qui] prend grand plaisir à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements !
fr.B: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Heureux tous ceux qui craignent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et qui trouvent leur grande joie dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements !
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Elle est vraiment belle, la vie des gens qui honorent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect et qui aiment faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} commande.

sw.L: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Heri yule anayemcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, apendezwaye sana na amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}!
sw.B: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Heri wote wanaomcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambao furaha yao kuu iko katika amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}!
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Maisha ni mazuri kweli kwa watu wanaomcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kupenda kufanya anayoyaamuru.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! ¡{{gender:Dichosa la persona|Dichoso el hombre}} [que] teme {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, [que] en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos se deleita mucho!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! ¡Qué dichosos son todos los que temen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, los que encuentran su gran deleite en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! Qué buena es la vida de quienes temen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y aman hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} manda.

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Phước thay người kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, [người] rất ưa thích các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.B: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Phước hạnh thay mọi người kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, những người lấy các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm niềm vui lớn!
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Thật hạnh phúc cho những người kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và thích làm theo điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} truyền dạy.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! 얼마나 복된가, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하며 그분의 계명을 크게 기뻐하는 사람은!
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하고 그분의 계명을 크게 기뻐하는 사람은 모두 얼마나 복된가!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려운 마음으로 섬기고 그분께서 명령하신 것을 즐겨 행하는 사람은 참으로 행복하다.

pt.L: Aleluia! Bem-aventurado [é] {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}} [que] teme {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, [que] muito se agrada dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos!
pt.B: Aleluia! Como são felizes todos os que temem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e têm grande prazer nos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos!
pt.R: Louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}}! Felizes de verdade são as pessoas que temem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e gostam de fazer o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} manda.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚፈራ፣ በትእዛዛቱም እጅግ ደስ የሚለው ሰው ምስጉን ነው!
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚፈራ፣ በትእዛዛቱም እጅግ ደስ የሚሰኝ ሰው የተባረከ ነው!
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚፈሩና እርሱ ያዘዘውን ማድረግ የሚወዱ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው በእውነት መልካም ነው።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो! कितना धन्य [है] वह {{gender:व्यक्ति|पुरुष}} [जो] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय मानता है, [जो] उनकी आज्ञाओं से अति प्रसन्न रहता है!
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो! कितने धन्य हैं वे सब जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय मानते हैं, जिनका बड़ा आनंद उनकी आज्ञाओं में है!
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो! उन लोगों का जीवन सचमुच अच्छा है जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय मानते हैं और उनकी आज्ञाओं पर चलना पसंद करते हैं।

ru.L: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}! Как блажен {{gender:человек|муж}}, [который] боится {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, [который] весьма радуется {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} заповедям!
ru.B: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}! Как блаженны все, кто боится {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, чья великая радость — {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} заповеди!
ru.R: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}! Жизнь по-настоящему хороша у тех, кто боится {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и любит исполнять то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} велит.

uk.L: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}! {{gender:Блаженна людина|Блаженний чоловік}}, що боїться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, що дуже втішається {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} заповідями!
uk.B: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}! Блаженні всі, хто боїться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, чия велика втіха — у {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} заповідях!
uk.R: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}! Справді добре живеться людям, які шанують {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і люблять робити те, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наказує.

decisions.choice: Praise the LORD: Hallelu-yah
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is two words: a plural command, "praise!" (hallelu), and Yah, the short form of the divine name (as in 68:5 and Exodus 15:2). It calls the gathered people to praise. Like the full name, Yah is rendered "the LORD", with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: an alphabet poem, twin to Psalm 111
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 111, after "Praise the LORD" each half line begins with the next letter of the Hebrew alphabet, and verses 9 and 10 have three lines each. Psalm 111 praises the LORD's works; this psalm draws the person who fears him, and gives that person words the other psalm used of God (verses 3, 4 and 9).

decisions.choice: How blessed: how good the life of
decisions.reason: As in 1:1: the word ('ashre) is an exclamation about a life that is truly good.

decisions.choice: who fears the LORD: picking up 111:10
decisions.reason: Psalm 111 ended with the fear of the LORD as the beginning of wisdom; this psalm describes the life of the person who has it.

decisions.choice: the person, they (with "the man", "he" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: The psalm draws one man ('ish) who stands for anyone who fears the LORD, so Literal keeps the singular portrait and the gender setting gives inclusive wording by default.

decisions.choice: people who ... they
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes one man ("he", "his") as a portrait of anyone who fears the LORD. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, which includes men and women alike and needs no setting; Literal keeps the singular.

decisions.choice: Life is truly good for
decisions.reason: As in 1:1.

decisions.choice: "l'être humain" under the gender setting, with "l'homme" as the alternative; the pronouns that follow in verses 2–9 ("il", "son", "sa") take no setting
alternatives: a setting on every pronoun, as the English Literal has
decisions.reason: French "l'être humain" is masculine, like "l'homme", so the pronouns that refer back to it are "il" in either wording and need no setting, as the French style guide sets. "La personne" would force "elle" in one option and "il" in the other.

decisions.choice: "qui honorent le SEIGNEUR avec respect" at Readable for "who fear the LORD"
decisions.reason: Readable says what fearing the LORD means, as the terms note sets for Readable (Psalm 111:10).

decisions.choice: "yule anayemcha" (the one who fears) at Literal, singular as in the Hebrew, with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as the English Literal has
decisions.reason: Swahili singular pronouns and verbs do not mark male or female, so "yule" and "yake" already include women and men, and the gender setting has nothing to change. Balanced and Readable use the plural, as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:Dichosa la persona|Dichoso el hombre}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ʾish is the man who fears the LORD, a picture of anyone who does. As in Psalm 1, Literal has a gender setting: "la persona" by default, "el hombre" as the alternative, with the agreeing words inside the span. Later lines of the psalm use Spanish forms that name no gender ("su", verbs without a pronoun), so the setting is needed only where an adjective agrees.

decisions.choice: plural: los que temen ... (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable speak of all who fear the LORD in the plural, as the English does, so the psalm reads as being about anyone who lives this way.

decisions.choice: "người" and "người ấy" (L), "những người" and "họ" (B, R) for the one who fears the LORD, with no gender spans in the psalm
alternatives: gender spans as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of "a man", and the English Literal offers "the person, they" or "the man, he". Vietnamese "người" and "người ấy" already mean a man or a woman, so there is no second form for the setting to show; Balanced and Readable use the plural as the English does. |

decisions.choice: No gender spans in this psalm: "사람" (person), and "그" or "그들" or no subject where the English has its spans
alternatives: gender spans offering "남자" or a masculine pronoun
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" means anyone, and Korean "그" for a person already spoken of, or no pronoun at all, carries no choice between "they" and "he" that the reader could switch, so Korean has no second wording to offer (style guide section 7; the published Psalm 1:1). Literal keeps one person, as the Hebrew does; Balanced and Readable speak of "그들", as the English does.

decisions.choice: o ser humano (with "o homem" as the alternative); no further gender spans in verses 2-9
decisions.reason: As in 1:1, Literal's portrait of one man ('ish) who stands for anyone (r-en-1) is "o ser humano", with "o homem" as the alternative. Both nouns are masculine in Portuguese, so the "ele", "seu" and adjectives that refer back to them in verses 2-9 are the same under either option and take no span, where the English needs "they (he)" each time.

decisions.choice: Como são felizes (B); Felizes de verdade (R)
decisions.reason: 'Ashre as the book has it (1:1), in the plural, since Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural as the English does (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 112
decisions.reason: Amharic has no deity_pronoun spans: the Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change. God is spoken of with the ordinary pronouns (እርሱ, አንተ) at every level.

decisions.choice: No gender spans: "ሰው" and the generic singular (L, B), the plural at Readable
decisions.reason: The English offers "the person|the man", "they|he" through the psalm. Amharic "ሰው" and the singular verb already speak of anyone, man or woman, so Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew singular with no span (as 2 Corinthians 9:9 does for verse 9), and Readable uses the plural, as its English and 2 Corinthians 9:9 Readable do.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; God is spoken of with the honorific third person.

decisions.choice: {{gender:व्यक्ति|पुरुष}} here and in verse 5; no spans on the pronouns
decisions.reason: The psalm draws one man ('ish) who stands for anyone who fears the LORD. Literal keeps the singular portrait with a gender span on the noun, as the English does; Hindi वह, उसका and उसे do not mark gender, so the pronouns in verses 2-9 need no span.

decisions.choice: человек (муж as the alternative)
alternatives: the English span on every pronoun
decisions.reason: The English Literal has gender spans on the noun and every pronoun. Russian puts the span only on the noun, "человек" with the traditional "муж" as the alternative; the pronouns "он", "его" agree with either and need none.

decisions.choice: plural (все, кто; те, кто)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable speak of all who fear the LORD in the plural, as the English does, so no setting is needed there.

source.text: גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑וֹ דּ֭וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Mighty in the land will be his offspring; [the] generation of [the] upright will be blessed.

en.L: Mighty in the land will be {{gender:their|his}} offspring; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
en.B: Their descendants will be powerful in the land, for the family of the upright is blessed.
en.R: Their children will become strong and important in the land. God blesses the families of people who do what is right.

fr.L: Puissante sur la terre sera sa descendance ; la génération des hommes droits sera bénie.
fr.B: Leurs descendants seront puissants dans le pays, car la famille des hommes droits est bénie.
fr.R: Leurs enfants deviendront forts et importants dans le pays. Dieu bénit les familles de ceux qui font ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Uzao wake utakuwa hodari katika nchi; kizazi cha wanyofu kitabarikiwa.
sw.B: Wazao wao watakuwa na nguvu katika nchi, kwa maana jamaa ya wanyofu imebarikiwa.
sw.R: Watoto wao watakuwa na nguvu na heshima katika nchi. Mungu huzibariki jamaa za watu wanaotenda yaliyo haki.

es.L: Poderosa en la tierra será su descendencia; la generación de los rectos será bendita.
es.B: Sus descendientes serán poderosos en la tierra, porque la familia de los rectos es bendecida.
es.R: Sus hijos llegarán a ser fuertes e importantes en la tierra. Dios bendice a las familias de los que hacen lo correcto.

vi.L: Mạnh mẽ trong xứ sẽ là dòng dõi người ấy; thế hệ của những người ngay thẳng sẽ được ban phước.
vi.B: Con cháu họ sẽ có thế lực trong xứ, vì dòng dõi người ngay thẳng được ban phước.
vi.R: Con cái họ sẽ trở nên mạnh mẽ và có địa vị trong xứ. Đức Chúa Trời ban phước cho gia đình của những người làm điều đúng.

ko.L: 그 사람의 자손은 땅에서 강한 자가 될 것이요, 정직한 이들의 세대는 복을 받을 것이다.
ko.B: 그들의 자손은 그 땅에서 힘 있는 사람이 될 것이니, 정직한 사람들의 집안은 복을 받기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그들의 자녀들은 그 땅에서 힘 있고 존경받는 사람이 될 것이다. 하나님께서는 정직하게 사는 사람들의 집안에 복을 주신다.

pt.L: Poderosa na terra será a sua descendência; a geração dos retos será abençoada.
pt.B: Os seus descendentes serão poderosos na terra, pois a família dos retos é abençoada.
pt.R: Os filhos deles vão se tornar fortes e importantes na terra. Deus abençoa as famílias das pessoas que fazem o que é certo.

am.L: ዘሩ በምድር ላይ ኃያል ይሆናል፤ የቅኖች ትውልድ ይባረካል።
am.B: ዘሮቹ በምድሪቱ ላይ ብርቱዎች ይሆናሉ፤ የቅኖች ትውልድ የተባረከ ነውና።
am.R: ልጆቻቸው በምድሪቱ ላይ ብርቱዎችና የተከበሩ ይሆናሉ። እግዚአብሔር ትክክል የሆነውን የሚያደርጉ ሰዎችን ቤተሰቦች ይባርካል።

hi.L: उसका वंश देश में पराक्रमी होगा; सीधे लोगों की पीढ़ी धन्य होगी।
hi.B: उनकी सन्तान देश में शक्तिशाली होगी, क्योंकि सीधे लोगों का कुल धन्य है।
hi.R: उनके बच्चे देश में बलवान और बड़े बनेंगे। परमेश्वर उन लोगों के परिवारों को आशीष देते हैं जो सही काम करते हैं।

ru.L: Сильным на земле будет его потомство; род прямодушных будет благословен.
ru.B: Их потомки будут сильны на земле, ведь род прямодушных благословен.
ru.R: Их дети станут сильными и уважаемыми на земле. Бог благословляет семьи тех, кто поступает правильно.

uk.L: Могутнім на землі буде {{gender:її|його}} потомство; рід праведних буде благословенний.
uk.B: Їхні нащадки будуть могутні на землі, бо рід праведних благословенний.
uk.R: Їхні діти стануть сильними й важливими в краї. Бог благословляє родини людей, які чинять правильно.

decisions.choice: mighty: strong, of standing in the land
decisions.reason: The word (gibbor) is used of warriors, and also of people of wealth and standing (Ruth 2:1).

decisions.choice: generation: the circle or family of the upright
decisions.reason: The word (dor) is a generation, and also a group of people of one kind (14:5; 24:6).

decisions.choice: the person, they (with "the man", "he" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: people who ... they
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: God blesses
decisions.reason: Readable names the one who blesses, whom the Hebrew passive implies.

records.literal_gloss: Wealth and riches [are] in his house, and his righteousness stands forever.

en.L: Wealth and riches [are] in {{gender:their|his}} house, and {{gender:their|his}} righteousness stands forever.
en.B: Their houses are full of wealth and riches, and their righteousness stands for all time.
en.R: Their homes are full of good things, and their righteousness will never end.

fr.L: Abondance et richesse [sont] dans sa maison, et sa justice subsiste pour toujours.
fr.B: Leurs maisons sont pleines d’abondance et de richesses, et leur justice demeure pour toujours.
fr.R: Leurs maisons sont remplies de bonnes choses, et leur justice n’aura jamais de fin.

sw.L: Mali na utajiri [vimo] nyumbani mwake, na haki yake inadumu milele.
sw.B: Nyumba zao zimejaa mali na utajiri, na haki yao inadumu nyakati zote.
sw.R: Nyumba zao zimejaa vitu vizuri, na haki yao haitakoma kamwe.

es.L: Bienes y riquezas [hay] en su casa, y su justicia permanece para siempre.
es.B: Sus casas están llenas de bienes y riquezas, y su justicia permanece para siempre.
es.R: Sus hogares están llenos de cosas buenas, y su justicia nunca se acabará.

vi.L: Của cải và giàu có [ở] trong nhà người ấy, và sự công chính của người ấy đứng vững đời đời.
vi.B: Nhà họ đầy của cải và giàu sang, và sự công chính của họ đứng vững muôn đời.
vi.R: Nhà họ đầy những điều tốt đẹp, và sự công chính của họ sẽ không bao giờ chấm dứt.

ko.L: 부와 재물이 그의 집에 [있고], 그의 의는 영원히 선다.
ko.B: 그들의 집에는 부와 재물이 가득하고, 그들의 의는 영원히 서 있다.
ko.R: 그들의 집에는 좋은 것이 가득하고, 그들의 의는 영원히 끝나지 않는다.

pt.L: Bens e riquezas [há] na sua casa, e a sua justiça permanece para sempre.
pt.B: As suas casas estão cheias de bens e riquezas, e a sua justiça permanece para sempre.
pt.R: As casas deles estão cheias de coisas boas, e a justiça deles nunca vai acabar.

am.L: ሀብትና ብልጽግና በቤቱ [አለ]፤ ጽድቁም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.B: ቤቱ በሀብትና በብልጽግና የተሞላ ነው፤ ጽድቁም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: ቤታቸው በመልካም ነገር የተሞላ ነው፤ ጽድቃቸውም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: उसके घर में धन और संपत्ति [है], और उसकी धार्मिकता सदा बनी रहती है।
hi.B: उनके घर धन और संपत्ति से भरे हैं, और उनकी धार्मिकता सदा बनी रहती है।
hi.R: उनके घर अच्छी चीज़ों से भरे हैं, और उनकी धार्मिकता कभी समाप्त न होगी।

ru.L: Достаток и богатство — в его доме, и его праведность стоит вовек.
ru.B: Их дома полны достатка и богатства, и их праведность пребывает вовек.
ru.R: Их дома полны добра, и их праведность никогда не кончится.

uk.L: Достаток і багатство — в {{gender:її|його}} домі, і {{gender:її|його}} праведність стоїть навіки.
uk.B: Їхні доми повні достатку й багатства, і їхня праведність стоїть на всі часи.
uk.R: Їхні домівки повні добра, і їхня праведність ніколи не скінчиться.

decisions.choice: his righteousness stands forever: the words of 111:3
decisions.reason: 111:3 said this of the LORD; here it is said of the person who fears him. That person's right living reflects God's own and is not forgotten.

decisions.choice: righteousness: right living, including generosity
decisions.reason: The word (tsedaqah) is right conduct. In verse 9 it is shown by giving to the poor, and in later Hebrew the word came to mean almsgiving.

decisions.choice: the person, they (with "the man", "he" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: people who ... they
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: a sua justiça permanece para sempre
alternatives: a sua justiça dura para sempre
decisions.reason: The same words as 111:3, said there of the LORD and here of the one who fears him (m1); verse 9 repeats them.

decisions.choice: "ጽድቁም ለዘላለም ይኖራል" at every level (R "ጽድቃቸውም"), as 111:3 and verse 9
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew line ends 111:3, 112:3 and 112:9, and 2 Corinthians 9:9 quotes it as "ጽድቁ ለዘላለም ይኖራል"; one wording for all three.

source.text: זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֭וֹרלַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃

records.literal_gloss: It rises in the darkness, light for the upright; gracious and compassionate and righteous.

en.L: Light rises in the darkness for the upright; [{{gender:they are|he is}}] gracious and compassionate and righteous.
en.B: When darkness falls, a light shines out for the upright: they are gracious, full of compassion, and righteous.
en.R: When times are dark, light will shine for people who do what is right. They are kind and caring, and they live rightly.

fr.L: La lumière se lève dans les ténèbres pour les hommes droits ; [il est] plein de grâce, de compassion et juste.
fr.B: Quand l’obscurité tombe, une lumière brille pour les hommes droits : ils sont pleins de grâce, de tendresse et de justice.
fr.R: Quand les temps sont sombres, la lumière brillera pour ceux qui font ce qui est juste. Ils sont bons et attentifs aux autres, et ils vivent de façon juste.

sw.L: Nuru huwazukia wanyofu gizani; [yeye ni] mwenye neema na huruma na haki.
sw.B: Giza linapoingia, nuru huwaangazia wanyofu: wao ni wenye neema, wamejaa huruma, na ni wenye haki.
sw.R: Nyakati za giza, nuru itawaangazia watu wanaotenda yaliyo haki. Wao ni wema na wenye huruma, nao huishi kwa haki.

es.L: Resplandece en las tinieblas la luz para los rectos; [es] clemente, {{gender:compasiva y justa|compasivo y justo}}.
es.B: Cuando cae la oscuridad, una luz brilla para los rectos: son clementes, llenos de compasión y justos.
es.R: Cuando llegan tiempos oscuros, la luz brillará para los que hacen lo correcto. Son bondadosos y compasivos, y viven con rectitud.

vi.L: Ánh sáng mọc lên trong bóng tối cho những người ngay thẳng; [người ấy] nhân từ, thương xót và công chính.
vi.B: Khi bóng tối phủ xuống, ánh sáng chiếu ra cho những người ngay thẳng: họ nhân từ, đầy lòng thương xót và công chính.
vi.R: Khi gặp lúc tối tăm, ánh sáng sẽ chiếu cho những người làm điều đúng. Họ tử tế, biết quan tâm, và sống ngay lành.

ko.L: 정직한 이들에게는 어둠 속에서 빛이 떠오르니, [그는] 은혜롭고 자비롭고 의롭다.
ko.B: 어둠이 내릴 때 정직한 사람들에게 빛이 비친다. 그들은 은혜롭고 자비가 많으며 의롭다.
ko.R: 어두운 때에도 옳은 일을 하는 사람들에게는 빛이 비칠 것이다. 그들은 친절하고 남을 아끼며 바르게 산다.

pt.L: Luz nasce nas trevas para os retos; [ele é] gracioso e compassivo e justo.
pt.B: Quando a escuridão chega, uma luz brilha para os retos: eles são bondosos, cheios de compaixão e justos.
pt.R: Quando os tempos são escuros, a luz vai brilhar para as pessoas que fazem o que é certo. Elas são bondosas e se importam com os outros, e vivem de modo correto.

am.L: ለቅኖች በጨለማ ውስጥ ብርሃን ይወጣል፤ [እርሱ] ቸርና ርኅሩኅ፣ ጻድቅም [ነው]።
am.B: ጨለማ በወደቀ ጊዜ ለቅኖች ብርሃን ይበራል፤ እርሱ ቸር፣ ርኅሩኅና ጻድቅ ነው።
am.R: የጨለማ ጊዜ ሲመጣ ትክክል የሆነውን ለሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ብርሃን ይወጣላቸዋል። እነርሱ ደጎችና አዛኞች ናቸው፤ በትክክልም ይኖራሉ።

hi.L: सीधे लोगों के लिए अंधकार में ज्योति उदय होती है; [वह] अनुग्रहकारी, दयालु और धर्मी [है]।
hi.B: जब अंधेरा छा जाता है, तब सीधे लोगों के लिए ज्योति चमक उठती है: वे अनुग्रहकारी, करुणा से भरे और धर्मी हैं।
hi.R: जब बुरे दिन आते हैं, तब भी जो सही काम करते हैं उनके लिए रोशनी चमकेगी। वे दयालु हैं, दूसरों की परवाह करते हैं, और सही जीवन जीते हैं।

ru.L: Восходит во тьме свет для прямодушных; [он] милостив, и милосерден, и праведен.
ru.B: Когда наступает тьма, для прямодушных сияет свет: они милостивы, полны сострадания и праведны.
ru.R: Когда приходят тёмные времена, для тех, кто поступает правильно, засияет свет. Они добры и заботливы, и они живут праведно.

uk.L: Світло сходить у темряві для праведних; [{{gender:вона|він}}] {{gender:милостива, милосердна й праведна|милостивий, милосердний і праведний}}.
uk.B: Коли западає темрява, для праведних засяює світло: вони милостиві, сповнені співчуття й праведні.
uk.R: Коли настають темні часи, світло сяятиме для людей, які чинять правильно. Вони добрі й чуйні, і живуть праведно.

decisions.choice: light rises in the darkness: help and joy come in trouble
decisions.reason: Light dawning is a picture of rescue and new hope after a time of trouble (97:11; Isaiah 58:10).

decisions.choice: gracious, compassionate, righteous: the upright person
alternatives: the LORD, who is gracious and compassionate and righteous
decisions.reason: The three words have no subject. In this psalm about the upright they most likely describe that person, who is like God: "gracious and compassionate" was said of the LORD in 111:4. They could also name the LORD as the light that rises.

decisions.choice: the person, they (with "the man", "he" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: people who ... they
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

source.text: טֽוֹב־אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: Good [is it for] a man [who] shows favor and lends; he conducts his affairs with justice.

en.L: Good [it is for] {{gender:the person|the man}} who shows favor and lends; {{gender:they conduct their|he conducts his}} affairs with justice.
en.B: Things go well for people who are kind and lend to others, and who handle their dealings with justice.
en.R: Life goes well for people who gladly lend to those in need. They are fair in all their business.

fr.L: Il est bon [pour] {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} qui fait grâce et qui prête ; il règle ses affaires avec justice.
fr.B: Tout va bien pour ceux qui sont bons et qui prêtent aux autres, et qui mènent leurs affaires avec justice.
fr.R: La vie se passe bien pour ceux qui prêtent volontiers à ceux qui sont dans le besoin. Ils sont honnêtes dans toutes leurs affaires.

sw.L: Ni vema kwa mtu anayefadhili na kukopesha; huendesha mambo yake kwa haki.
sw.B: Mambo huwaendea vema watu walio wema na kuwakopesha wengine, na wanaoshughulikia mambo yao kwa haki.
sw.R: Maisha huwaendea vema watu wanaowakopesha kwa moyo mkunjufu wale wenye shida. Wao ni waadilifu katika biashara zao zote.

es.L: Bien [le va] a {{gender:la persona|al hombre}} que se compadece y presta; conduce sus asuntos con justicia.
es.B: Les va bien a los que son generosos y prestan a otros, y llevan sus negocios con justicia.
es.R: A la gente que presta con gusto a los necesitados le va bien en la vida. Son justos en todos sus negocios.

vi.L: Tốt [thay cho] người tỏ lòng thương và cho vay; người ấy điều hành công việc mình theo công lý.
vi.B: Mọi sự tốt đẹp cho những người nhân hậu, sẵn lòng cho người khác vay, và xử sự công minh trong mọi việc.
vi.R: Cuộc sống tốt đẹp cho những người vui lòng cho người túng thiếu vay mượn. Họ công bằng trong mọi việc làm ăn.

ko.L: 은혜를 베풀고 꾸어 주는 사람에게는 좋다. 그는 정의로 자기 일을 처리한다.
ko.B: 너그럽게 베풀고 남에게 꾸어 주며, 정의롭게 자기 일을 처리하는 사람은 잘된다.
ko.R: 어려운 사람에게 기꺼이 꾸어 주는 사람은 잘 산다. 그들은 모든 거래에서 공정하다.

pt.L: Bem [vai] {{gender:ao ser humano|ao homem}} que se compadece e empresta; ele conduz os seus negócios com justiça.
pt.B: As coisas vão bem para quem é bondoso e empresta aos outros, e trata dos seus negócios com justiça.
pt.R: A vida vai bem para as pessoas que emprestam com alegria a quem precisa. Elas são justas em todos os seus negócios.

am.L: የሚራራና የሚያበድር ሰው መልካም ይሆንለታል፤ ጉዳዩን በፍርድ ያከናውናል።
am.B: ቸር ሆኖ ለሌሎች የሚያበድርና ሥራውን በፍትሕ የሚያከናውን ሰው ነገር ይሳካለታል።
am.R: ለተቸገሩ በደስታ የሚያበድሩ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው ይቃናል። በሥራቸው ሁሉ ትክክለኞች ናቸው።

hi.L: भला [है उस] {{gender:व्यक्ति|पुरुष}} [का] जो अनुग्रह करता और उधार देता है; वह अपने काम न्याय से चलाता है।
hi.B: उन लोगों का भला होता है जो दया करते और दूसरों को उधार देते हैं, और अपने लेन-देन न्याय से करते हैं।
hi.R: उन लोगों का जीवन अच्छा चलता है जो ज़रूरतमंदों को ख़ुशी से उधार देते हैं। वे अपने सारे कारोबार में ईमानदार रहते हैं।

ru.L: Хорошо {{gender:человеку|мужу}}, милующему и дающему взаймы; он ведёт свои дела по справедливости.
ru.B: Хорошо живётся тем, кто добр и даёт взаймы другим, и кто ведёт свои дела по справедливости.
ru.R: Хорошо живётся тем, кто охотно даёт взаймы нуждающимся. Они честны во всех своих делах.

uk.L: Добре [тій] {{gender:людині|чоловікові}}, {{gender:яка|який}} милує й позичає; {{gender:вона|він}} веде свої справи справедливо.
uk.B: Добре ведеться тим, хто добрий і позичає іншим, і хто провадить свої справи справедливо.
uk.R: Добре живеться людям, які охоче позичають тим, хто в нужді. Вони чесні в усіх своїх справах.

decisions.choice: good for a man: it goes well with the one who
alternatives: a good man is one who
decisions.reason: "Good" comes first, followed by "a man": it most likely says that life goes well for such a person, as in Jeremiah 44:17, rather than defining a good man.

decisions.choice: shows favor and lends: helping the poor without gain
decisions.reason: The verb (chanan) is to show kindness or favor. The law told Israel to lend to the poor and not to charge them interest (Leviticus 25:35-37; Deuteronomy 15:7-8; Psalm 15:5); 37:26 says the same of the righteous.

decisions.choice: conducts his affairs: manages his business
decisions.reason: The verb (kul, here with doubled form) means to sustain or manage; "his affairs" (devarav) can be his dealings or his case at law. Either way, he acts with justice.

decisions.choice: the person, they (with "the man", "he" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: people who ... they
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

source.text: כִּֽי־לְעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־יִמּ֑וֹט לְזֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק׃

records.literal_gloss: For forever not he will be shaken; for a remembrance forever will be [the] righteous.

en.L: For forever {{gender:they|he}} will not be shaken; [the] righteous will be [held] in remembrance forever.
en.B: They will never be overthrown; the righteous will be remembered for all time.
en.R: Nothing will ever knock them down. People will always remember those who do what is right.

fr.L: Car il ne sera jamais ébranlé ; le juste sera [gardé] en souvenir pour toujours.
fr.B: Ils ne seront jamais renversés ; on se souviendra du juste pour toujours.
fr.R: Rien ne pourra jamais les faire tomber. On se souviendra toujours de ceux qui font ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Kwa maana milele hatatikiswa; mwenye haki atakuwa [katika] ukumbusho milele.
sw.B: Hawatapinduliwa kamwe; mwenye haki atakumbukwa nyakati zote.
sw.R: Hakuna kitakachowaangusha kamwe. Watu watawakumbuka daima wale wanaotenda yaliyo haki.

es.L: Porque jamás vacilará; en memoria eterna estará [el] justo.
es.B: Nunca serán derribados; el justo será recordado para siempre.
es.R: Nada los derribará jamás. La gente siempre recordará a los que hacen lo correcto.

vi.L: Vì đời đời người ấy sẽ không bị lay động; người công chính sẽ được ghi nhớ đời đời.
vi.B: Họ sẽ không bao giờ bị lật đổ; người công chính sẽ được ghi nhớ muôn đời.
vi.R: Không gì có thể quật ngã họ. Người ta sẽ luôn nhớ đến những người làm điều đúng.

ko.L: 참으로 그는 영원히 흔들리지 않을 것이니, 의인은 영원히 기억될 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 결코 넘어지지 않을 것이요, 의인은 영원히 기억될 것이다.
ko.R: 그 무엇도 그들을 쓰러뜨리지 못할 것이다. 사람들은 바르게 사는 사람들을 언제까지나 기억할 것이다.

pt.L: Porque para sempre ele não será abalado; o justo será [lembrado] em memória eterna.
pt.B: Eles nunca serão derrubados; o justo será lembrado para sempre.
pt.R: Nada vai conseguir derrubá-los. As pessoas sempre vão se lembrar dos que fazem o que é certo.

am.R: ምንም ነገር ሊጥላቸው አይችልም። ሰዎች ትክክል የሆነውን የሚያደርጉትን ሁልጊዜ ያስታውሷቸዋል።

hi.L: क्योंकि वह कभी नहीं डगमगाएगा; धर्मी सदा स्मरण में [रहेगा]।
hi.B: वे कभी उखाड़े न जाएँगे; धर्मी सदा याद किए जाएँगे।
hi.R: कोई चीज़ उन्हें कभी गिरा न सकेगी। लोग उन्हें सदा याद रखेंगे जो सही काम करते हैं।

ru.L: Ведь вовек он не поколеблется; в вечной памяти будет праведный.
ru.B: Они никогда не будут поколеблены; праведных будут помнить во все времена.
ru.R: Ничто никогда не сможет их свалить. Люди всегда будут помнить тех, кто поступает правильно.

uk.L: Бо повік {{gender:вона|він}} не похитнеться; праведний буде [у] памʼяті навіки.
uk.B: Їх ніколи не повалять; праведних памʼятатимуть на всі часи.
uk.R: Ніщо ніколи їх не звалить. Люди завжди памʼятатимуть тих, хто чинить правильно.

decisions.choice: shaken: moved from a firm place, overthrown
decisions.reason: The verb (mot) is used of what stands firm and cannot be toppled (15:5; 16:8).

decisions.choice: a remembrance forever: never forgotten
decisions.reason: Their name and their good deeds will be remembered, while the name of the wicked rots (Proverbs 10:7).

decisions.choice: the person, they (with "the man", "he" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: people who ... they
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: People will always remember
decisions.reason: Readable says who remembers.

decisions.choice: "người công chính" for the righteous (L, B), "những người làm điều đúng" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "người công chính" for tsaddiq; Readable says plainly what it means, as the English Readable does. |

source.text: מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Of bad news not he will be afraid; firm [is] his heart, trusting in YHWH.

en.L: Of bad news {{gender:they|he}} will not be afraid; firm [is] {{gender:their|his}} heart, trusting in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Bad news does not frighten them; their hearts stand firm because they trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: They are not afraid of bad news. They stay calm and sure, because they trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: D’une mauvaise nouvelle il n’aura pas peur ; ferme [est] son cœur, confiant {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Les mauvaises nouvelles ne leur font pas peur ; leur cœur reste ferme, car ils ont confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ils n’ont pas peur des mauvaises nouvelles. Ils restent calmes et confiants, parce qu’ils comptent sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Habari mbaya hataziogopa; moyo wake [ni] thabiti, ukimtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Habari mbaya haziwatishi; mioyo yao iko imara kwa sababu wanamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Hawaogopi habari mbaya. Hubaki watulivu na wenye uhakika, kwa sababu wanamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: De malas noticias no tendrá temor; firme [está] su corazón, confiado en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Las malas noticias no los asustan; su corazón se mantiene firme porque confían en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: No tienen miedo de las malas noticias. Se mantienen tranquilos y seguros, porque confían en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Trước tin dữ người ấy sẽ không sợ hãi; vững vàng [là] lòng người ấy, tin cậy nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Tin xấu không làm họ khiếp sợ; lòng họ vững vàng vì họ tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Họ không sợ khi nghe tin xấu. Họ luôn bình tĩnh và vững vàng, vì họ tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그는 나쁜 소식을 두려워하지 않을 것이니, 그의 마음이 굳건하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 신뢰한다.
ko.B: 나쁜 소식이 들려와도 그들은 두려워하지 않는다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 신뢰하기에 마음이 굳건하다.
ko.R: 그들은 나쁜 소식을 무서워하지 않는다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿고 의지하기 때문에 마음이 평안하고 든든하다.

pt.L: De má notícia ele não terá medo; firme [está] o seu coração, confiando {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}.
pt.B: Más notícias não os assustam; o coração deles está firme, porque confiam {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}.
pt.R: Eles não têm medo de más notícias. Ficam calmos e seguros, porque confiam {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}.

am.L: ከክፉ ወሬ አይፈራም፤ ልቡ ጽኑ ነው፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ይታመናል።
am.B: ክፉ ወሬ አያስደነግጠውም፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስለሚታመን ልቡ ጸንቶ ይቆማል።
am.R: ክፉ ወሬ አያስፈራቸውም። {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስለሚታመኑ ተረጋግተውና ጸንተው ይኖራሉ።

hi.L: वह बुरे समाचार से नहीं डरेगा; उसका हृदय दृढ़ [है], {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर भरोसा रखता हुआ।
hi.B: बुरा समाचार उन्हें नहीं डराता; उनके हृदय दृढ़ रहते हैं, क्योंकि वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर भरोसा रखते हैं।
hi.R: वे बुरी ख़बर से नहीं डरते। वे शांत और निश्चिंत रहते हैं, क्योंकि वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर भरोसा रखते हैं।

ru.L: Худой вести он не убоится; твёрдо его сердце, уповающее на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Плохие вести не пугают их; их сердца тверды, потому что они уповают на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Они не боятся плохих вестей. Они остаются спокойными и уверенными, потому что надеются на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

uk.L: Лихої звістки {{gender:вона|він}} не злякається; тверде {{gender:її|його}} серце, що покладається на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Лиха звістка не лякає їх; їхні серця стоять твердо, бо вони покладаються на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Вони не бояться лихих новин. Вони залишаються спокійними й упевненими, бо довіряють {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: firm: settled, ready
decisions.reason: The word (nakhon) means set firm, established (57:8; 108:2). The heart is steady, not shaken by what it hears.

decisions.choice: trusting: the reason the heart is firm
decisions.reason: The participle (batuach) explains the steadiness: it rests on trust in the LORD.

decisions.choice: the person, they (with "the man", "he" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: people who ... they
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: stay calm and sure
decisions.reason: Readable says what a firm heart is (m1).

source.text: סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּוֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Upheld [is] his heart, not he will be afraid, until he looks on his foes.

en.L: Upheld [is] {{gender:their|his}} heart; {{gender:they|he}} will not be afraid, until {{gender:they look|he looks}} on {{gender:their|his}} foes.
en.B: Their hearts are held steady and they will not be afraid, until they see what becomes of their enemies.
en.R: Their hearts are strong, so they will not be afraid. One day they will see their enemies defeated.

fr.L: Affermi [est] son cœur ; il n’aura pas peur, jusqu’à ce qu’il voie [la chute de] ses adversaires.
fr.B: Leur cœur est soutenu, et ils n’auront pas peur, jusqu’à ce qu’ils voient ce qui arrive à leurs ennemis.
fr.R: Leur cœur est solide, alors ils n’auront pas peur. Un jour, ils verront leurs ennemis vaincus.

sw.L: Moyo wake umetegemezwa; hataogopa, hadi atakapowatazama watesi wake.
sw.B: Mioyo yao imeshikiliwa imara wala hawataogopa, mpaka waone yatakayowapata adui zao.
sw.R: Mioyo yao ina nguvu, kwa hiyo hawataogopa. Siku moja watawaona adui zao wameshindwa.

es.L: Sostenido [está] su corazón; no temerá, hasta que mire a sus adversarios.
es.B: Su corazón se mantiene firme y no tendrán miedo, hasta que vean lo que les pasa a sus enemigos.
es.R: Su corazón es fuerte, así que no tendrán miedo. Un día verán derrotados a sus enemigos.

vi.L: Được nâng đỡ [là] lòng người ấy; người ấy sẽ không sợ hãi, cho đến khi người ấy nhìn thấy [kết cuộc] kẻ thù mình.
vi.B: Lòng họ được giữ vững và họ sẽ không sợ hãi, cho đến khi họ thấy kết cuộc của kẻ thù mình.
vi.R: Lòng họ mạnh mẽ, nên họ sẽ không sợ hãi. Một ngày kia họ sẽ thấy kẻ thù mình bị đánh bại.

ko.L: 그의 마음이 붙들려 있으니, 그가 그의 대적들을 [내려다]볼 때까지 두려워하지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그들의 마음은 흔들림 없이 붙들려 있어서, 원수들이 어떻게 되는지 볼 때까지 두려워하지 않는다.
ko.R: 그들은 마음이 강하여 두려워하지 않을 것이다. 언젠가 그들은 원수들이 패하는 것을 보게 될 것이다.

pt.L: Firmado [está] o seu coração; ele não terá medo, até que veja [a derrota dos] seus adversários.
pt.B: O coração deles está sustentado, e eles não terão medo, até verem o que acontece com os seus inimigos.
pt.R: O coração deles é forte, por isso não vão ter medo. Um dia vão ver os seus inimigos derrotados.

am.L: ልቡ የተደገፈ ነው፤ አይፈራም፤ በባላጋራዎቹ ላይ እስኪያይ ድረስ።
am.B: ልቡ የጸና ነው፤ አይፈራምም፤ በባላጋራዎቹ ላይ የሚደርሰውን እስኪያይ ድረስ።
am.R: ልባቸው ብርቱ ነው፤ ስለዚህ አይፈሩም። አንድ ቀን ጠላቶቻቸው ድል ሆነው ያያሉ።

hi.L: उसका हृदय सँभला हुआ [है]; वह नहीं डरेगा, यहाँ तक कि वह अपने बैरियों [का अंत] देख लेगा।
hi.B: उनके हृदय स्थिर रखे जाते हैं और वे नहीं डरेंगे, जब तक वे यह न देख लें कि उनके शत्रुओं का क्या हुआ।
hi.R: उनके हृदय मज़बूत हैं, इसलिए वे नहीं डरेंगे। एक दिन वे अपने शत्रुओं को हारा हुआ देखेंगे।

ru.L: Утверждено его сердце; он не убоится, пока не посмотрит на своих врагов.
ru.B: Их сердца крепки, и они не будут бояться, пока не увидят, что станет с их врагами.
ru.R: Их сердца сильны, поэтому они не будут бояться. Однажды они увидят своих врагов побеждёнными.

uk.L: Підтримане {{gender:її|його}} серце; {{gender:вона|він}} не боятиметься, аж поки не подивиться на своїх супротивників.
uk.B: Їхні серця тримаються міцно, і вони не боятимуться, аж поки не побачать, що станеться з їхніми ворогами.
uk.R: Їхні серця сильні, тож вони не боятимуться. Одного дня вони побачать своїх ворогів переможеними.

decisions.choice: look on his foes: see their downfall
decisions.reason: To "look on" enemies is to see them defeated (54:9; 59:11; 118:7).

decisions.choice: upheld: supported, kept steady
decisions.reason: The verb (samakh) is to lean on or hold up; it is used of the LORD's precepts in 111:8. The same root describes the heart held firm by trust.

decisions.choice: the person, they (with "the man", "he" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: people who ... they
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: see their enemies defeated
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m1).

source.text: פִּזַּ֤ר׀נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתוֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: He has scattered, he has given to the needy; his righteousness stands forever; his horn will be exalted in honor.

en.L: {{gender:They have|He has}} scattered, {{gender:they have|he has}} given to the needy; {{gender:their|his}} righteousness stands forever; {{gender:their|his}} horn will be lifted high in honor.
en.B: They have given generously, spreading their gifts among the needy; their righteousness stands for all time, and their strength will rise in honor.
en.R: They give freely to poor people. Their righteousness will never end. They will be made strong and honored.

fr.L: Il a dispersé, il a donné aux pauvres ; sa justice subsiste pour toujours ; sa corne sera élevée avec gloire.
fr.B: Ils ont donné largement, distribuant leurs dons aux pauvres ; leur justice demeure pour toujours, et leur force s’élèvera avec honneur.
fr.R: Ils donnent généreusement aux pauvres. Leur justice n’aura jamais de fin. Ils seront rendus forts et honorés.

sw.L: Ametawanya, amewapa wahitaji; haki yake inadumu milele; pembe yake itainuliwa kwa heshima.
sw.B: Wametoa kwa ukarimu, wakigawa zawadi zao kwa wahitaji; haki yao inadumu nyakati zote, na nguvu zao zitainuliwa kwa heshima.
sw.R: Huwapa maskini bila kujinyima. Haki yao haitakoma kamwe. Watafanywa wenye nguvu na kuheshimiwa.

es.L: Ha repartido, ha dado a los necesitados; su justicia permanece para siempre; su cuerno será exaltado con honra.
es.B: Han dado con generosidad, repartiendo sus dones entre los necesitados; su justicia permanece para siempre, y su fuerza se alzará con honor.
es.R: Dan con generosidad a los pobres. Su justicia nunca se acabará. Serán fuertes y honrados.

vi.L: Người ấy đã phân phát, người ấy đã ban cho người thiếu thốn; sự công chính của người ấy đứng vững đời đời; sừng của người ấy sẽ được ngước cao trong vinh dự.
vi.B: Họ đã rộng rãi ban phát, chia sẻ của cải cho người thiếu thốn; sự công chính của họ đứng vững muôn đời, và sức mạnh của họ sẽ được nâng cao trong vinh dự.
vi.R: Họ rộng rãi cho người nghèo. Sự công chính của họ sẽ không bao giờ chấm dứt. Họ sẽ được làm cho mạnh mẽ và được tôn trọng.

ko.L: 그는 흩어 주었고, 궁핍한 이들에게 주었으니, 그의 의는 영원히 서고, 그의 뿔은 영광 가운데 높이 들릴 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 아낌없이 나누어 궁핍한 이들에게 주었으니, 그들의 의는 영원히 서 있고, 그들의 힘은 영예롭게 높아질 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 가난한 사람들에게 아낌없이 준다. 그들의 의는 영원히 끝나지 않는다. 그들은 힘 있고 존귀하게 될 것이다.

pt.L: Espalhou, deu aos pobres; a sua justiça permanece para sempre; o seu chifre será exaltado com honra.
pt.B: Distribuíram com generosidade, repartindo os seus dons entre os necessitados; a justiça deles permanece para sempre, e a sua força será exaltada com honra.
pt.R: Elas dão de boa vontade aos pobres. A justiça delas vai durar para sempre. Elas vão ser fortes e honradas.

am.L: በተነ፣ ለድሆች ሰጠ፤ ጽድቁ ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ ቀንዱም በክብር ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።
am.B: ስጦታውን በየቦታው በተነ፤ ለተቸገሩትም ሰጠ፤ ጽድቁ ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ ብርታቱም በክብር ከፍ ይላል።
am.R: ለድሆች በልግስና ይሰጣሉ። ጽድቃቸው ለዘላለም ይኖራል። ብርቱዎችና የተከበሩም ይሆናሉ።

hi.L: उसने बिखेरा, उसने कंगालों को दिया; उसकी धार्मिकता सदा बनी रहती है; उसका सींग आदर के साथ ऊँचा किया जाएगा।
hi.B: उन्होंने अपने दान दूर-दूर तक बिखेरे हैं और ज़रूरतमंदों को दिया है; उनकी धार्मिकता सदा बनी रहती है, और उनका बल आदर के साथ ऊँचा उठेगा।
hi.R: वे ग़रीबों को खुले हाथ से देते हैं। उनकी धार्मिकता सदा बनी रहेगी। वे बलवान बनाए जाएँगे और उनका आदर होगा।

ru.L: Он расточил, дал бедным; праведность его пребывает вовек; рог его вознесётся в славе.
ru.B: Они щедро раздавали свои дары и давали нуждающимся; праведность их пребывает вовек, и сила их возвысится в чести.
ru.R: Они щедро дают бедным. Их праведность будет жить вечно. Они станут сильными и уважаемыми.

uk.L: {{gender:Вона розсипала|Він розсипав}}, {{gender:вона дала|він дав}} убогим; {{gender:її|його}} праведність стоїть навіки; {{gender:її|його}} ріг піднесеться в славі.
uk.B: Вони щедро давали, роздаючи свої дари убогим; їхня праведність стоїть на всі часи, і їхня сила підніметься в честі.
uk.R: Вони щедро дають бідним людям. Їхня праведність ніколи не скінчиться. Вони стануть сильними й шанованими.

decisions.choice: scattered: given widely and freely
decisions.reason: The verb (pizzar) is to scatter or spread, as a farmer scatters seed: the person gives widely and generously.

decisions.choice: quoted in 2 Corinthians 9:9
decisions.reason: Paul quotes these lines, from the ancient Greek translation, to encourage the Corinthians to give generously to the poor.

decisions.choice: horn: strength and dignity
decisions.reason: A horn is a picture of an animal's strength and pride (75:11; 89:25; 92:11). To have the horn lifted high is to be made strong and honored.

decisions.choice: the person, they (with "the man", "he" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: people who ... they
decisions.reason: As in 112:1.

decisions.choice: their strength
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the horn stands for (m3), as in 89:18.

decisions.choice: Espalhou, deu aos pobres; a sua justiça permanece para sempre (L); Elas dão de boa vontade aos pobres. A justiça delas vai durar para sempre. (R)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes these lines in 2 Corinthians 9:9 (m2), so Literal and Readable keep the words of its Portuguese, which fit the Hebrew; Balanced keeps the plural portrait of the psalm (r-en-2), where 2 Corinthians has one giver, and says "os necessitados" for the Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: «በተነ፣ ለድሆች ሰጠ፤ ጽድቁ ለዘላለም ይኖራል» (L), B «ስጦታውን በየቦታው በተነ፤ ለተቸገሩትም ሰጠ፤ ጽድቁ ለዘላለም ይኖራል», R «ለድሆች በልግስና ይሰጣሉ። ጽድቃቸው ለዘላለም ይኖራል», as 2 Corinthians 9:9
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the first two lines, and the Hebrew agrees with the Greek, so the Amharic New Testament's wording is kept; the last line (the horn) follows the Hebrew. "horn" is "ቀንድ" at Literal and "ብርታት" (strength) at Balanced, as the English.

decisions.choice: wording of 2 Corinthians 9:9
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the first two lines, and Hindi keeps his wording at each level; Balanced puts it in the plural (उन्होंने, उनकी), because this psalm's Balanced speaks of the generous in the plural, as the English does. The third line, which Paul does not quote, follows.

decisions.choice: the words of 2 Corinthians 9:9
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the first two lines and the Hebrew says the same, so each level keeps the Russian of 2 Corinthians 9:9; Balanced puts it in the plural, as this psalm's Balanced speaks of all who fear the LORD.

decisions.choice: рог
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the horn; Balanced and Readable say what it stands for, as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: [The] wicked will see and be vexed; his teeth he will gnash and melt away; [the] desire of [the] wicked will perish.

en.L: The wicked will see and be vexed; he will gnash his teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked will perish.
en.B: The wicked see it and are galled; they grind their teeth and melt away; what the wicked long for is lost.
en.R: Wicked people will see this and be angry. They will grind their teeth, and they will fade away. What they want will never happen.

fr.L: Le méchant [le] verra et s’irritera ; il grincera des dents et se consumera ; le désir des méchants périra.
fr.B: Les méchants le voient et enragent ; ils grincent des dents et se défont ; ce que désirent les méchants est perdu.
fr.R: Les méchants verront cela et seront en colère. Ils grinceront des dents, et ils disparaîtront. Ce qu’ils veulent n’arrivera jamais.

sw.L: Mwovu ataona na kuudhika; atasaga meno yake na kuyeyuka; tamaa ya waovu itapotea.
sw.B: Waovu wanaona hayo wakachukizwa; wanasaga meno na kuyeyuka; kile wanachokitamani waovu kinapotea.
sw.R: Watu waovu wataona hayo na kukasirika. Watasaga meno, nao watatoweka. Wanachokitaka hakitatokea kamwe.

es.L: El malvado [lo] verá y se irritará; rechinará sus dientes y se consumirá; el deseo de los malvados perecerá.
es.B: Los malvados lo ven y se enfurecen; rechinan los dientes y se consumen; lo que los malvados anhelan se pierde.
es.R: Los malvados verán esto y se enojarán. Rechinarán los dientes y se irán desvaneciendo. Lo que ellos quieren nunca sucederá.

vi.L: Kẻ ác sẽ thấy và tức giận; hắn sẽ nghiến răng và tan biến; điều kẻ ác ao ước sẽ tiêu mất.
vi.B: Kẻ ác thấy vậy thì tức tối; chúng nghiến răng rồi tan biến; điều kẻ ác mong muốn sẽ tiêu tan.
vi.R: Kẻ ác sẽ thấy điều này và nổi giận. Chúng sẽ nghiến răng, rồi tan biến dần. Điều chúng mong muốn sẽ không bao giờ thành.

ko.L: 악인은 보고 분해할 것이요, 이를 갈다가 녹아 없어질 것이니, 악인들의 욕망은 사라질 것이다.
ko.B: 악인들은 그것을 보고 분통을 터뜨리고, 이를 갈다가 녹아 사라진다. 악인들이 바라는 것은 사라지고 만다.
ko.R: 악한 사람들은 이것을 보고 화를 낼 것이다. 그들은 이를 갈다가 사라져 버릴 것이다. 그들이 바라는 것은 결코 이루어지지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: O ímpio verá e se irritará; rangerá os seus dentes e se derreterá; o desejo dos ímpios perecerá.
pt.B: Os ímpios veem isso e se enfurecem; rangem os dentes e se desfazem; o que os ímpios desejam se perde.
pt.R: As pessoas más vão ver isso e ficar com raiva. Vão ranger os dentes e desaparecer. O que elas querem nunca vai acontecer.

am.L: ክፉ ሰው ያያል፤ ይናደዳልም፤ ጥርሱን ያፋጫል፤ ይቀልጣልም፤ የክፉዎች ምኞት ትጠፋለች።
am.B: ክፉዎች ይህን አይተው ይበሳጫሉ፤ ጥርሳቸውን ያፋጫሉ፤ ቀልጠውም ይጠፋሉ፤ ክፉዎች የሚመኙት ይጠፋል።
am.R: ክፉ ሰዎች ይህን አይተው ይቆጣሉ። ጥርሳቸውን ያፋጫሉ፤ እየደከሙም ይጠፋሉ። የሚፈልጉት ፈጽሞ አይሆንም።

hi.L: दुष्ट देखेगा और कुढ़ेगा; वह अपने दाँत पीसेगा और गल जाएगा; दुष्टों की लालसा नाश हो जाएगी।
hi.B: दुष्ट यह देखकर जल उठते हैं; वे दाँत पीसते हैं और गल जाते हैं; दुष्टों की लालसा मिट जाती है।
hi.R: दुष्ट लोग यह देखकर क्रोधित होंगे। वे दाँत पीसेंगे, और मिट जाएँगे। वे जो चाहते हैं, वह कभी पूरा न होगा।

ru.L: Нечестивый увидит и раздосадуется; он заскрежещет зубами и истает; желание нечестивых погибнет.
ru.B: Нечестивые видят это и злятся; они скрежещут зубами и тают; то, чего желают нечестивые, пропадёт.
ru.R: Злые люди увидят это и рассердятся. Они будут скрипеть зубами и исчезнут. То, чего они хотят, никогда не сбудется.

uk.L: Нечестивий побачить і розгнівається; він заскреготить своїми зубами й розтане; бажання нечестивих загине.
uk.B: Нечестиві бачать це, і їм гірко; вони скреготять зубами й тануть; те, чого прагнуть нечестиві, пропадає.
uk.R: Злі люди побачать це й розлютяться. Вони скреготітимуть зубами й зникнуть. Те, чого вони хочуть, ніколи не станеться.

decisions.choice: gnash the teeth: show helpless rage
decisions.reason: Grinding the teeth is a sign of fury (35:16; 37:12). Here the wicked can only rage at the good that comes to the righteous.

decisions.choice: the desire of the wicked will perish: the end of Psalm 1
decisions.reason: The same verb ends Psalm 1 ("the way of the wicked will perish", 1:6). With the letter taw, the last of the alphabet, the poem closes on the end of the wicked.

decisions.choice: the wicked ... they
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes "the wicked" as one person ("he", "his") who stands for all who act this way. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, which is how "the wicked" is heard in English and includes men and women alike; Literal keeps the Hebrew singular.

decisions.choice: o desejo dos ímpios perecerá
alternatives: o desejo dos ímpios se acabará
decisions.reason: The verb is the one that ends Psalm 1 (m2), "perecerá" as in 1:6, so the two psalms end on the same word.
